agent_actions_approval_check.name: agent_actions_approval_check
agent_actions_approval_check.value: approval_status is null or approval_status in ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')

agent_actions_confidence_check.name: agent_actions_confidence_check
agent_actions_confidence_check.value: confidence is null or (confidence >= 0 and confidence <= 1)

venues_address_check.name: venues_address_check
venues_address_check.value: venue_type = 'area' or address is not null

venues_parent_check.name: venues_parent_check
venues_parent_check.value: parent_venue_id is null or parent_venue_id <> id

link_policies_homepage_check.name: link_policies_homepage_check
link_policies_homepage_check.value: mode = 'deep' or (homepage_url is not null and homepage_url ~ '^https://')

sources_kind_check.name: sources_kind_check
sources_kind_check.value: kind is null or kind in ('api', 'ics', 'rss', 'jsonld_sitemap', 'html')

sources_enabled_check.name: sources_enabled_check
sources_enabled_check.value: not enabled or (kind is not null and fetcher is not null)

sources_disabled_reason_check.name: sources_disabled_reason_check
sources_disabled_reason_check.value: (enabled and disabled_reason is null) or (not enabled and disabled_reason is not null and disabled_reason in ('untested', 'awaiting_permission', 'blocked', 'manual'))

raw_records_skip_check.name: raw_records_skip_check
raw_records_skip_check.value: status <> 'skipped' or skip_reason is not null

raw_records_needs_venue_check.name: raw_records_needs_venue_check
raw_records_needs_venue_check.value: status <> 'needs_venue' or location_key is not null

raw_records_mapped_check.name: raw_records_mapped_check
raw_records_mapped_check.value: status not in ('mapped', 'extracted') or (facts is not null and venue_id is not null)

event_days_hours_check.name: event_days_hours_check
event_days_hours_check.value: closes_at is null or opens_at is null or closes_at > opens_at

events_end_check.name: events_end_check
events_end_check.value: end_at is null or end_at >= start_at

events_price_check.name: events_price_check
events_price_check.value: (price_min is null or price_min >= 0) and (price_max is null or price_min is null or price_max >= price_min)

events_canonical_check.name: events_canonical_check
events_canonical_check.value: canonical_event_id is null or canonical_event_id <> id

events_parent_check.name: events_parent_check
events_parent_check.value: parent_event_id is null or parent_event_id <> id

events_free_basis_value_check.name: events_free_basis_value_check
events_free_basis_value_check.value: free_basis is null or free_basis in ('stated', 'source_default')

events_age_check.name: events_age_check
events_age_check.value: (age_min is null or age_min between 0 and 120) and (age_max is null or age_max between 0 and 120) and (age_min is null or age_max is null or age_max >= age_min) and (grade_min is null or grade_min between 0 and 12) and (grade_max is null or grade_max between 0 and 12) and (grade_min is null or grade_max is null or grade_max >= grade_min)

dedup_candidates_confidence_check.name: dedup_candidates_confidence_check
dedup_candidates_confidence_check.value: confidence is null or (confidence >= 0 and confidence <= 1)

places_google_check.name: places_google_check
places_google_check.value: (google_place_id is null) = (google_place_id_confirmed_at is null) and (google_place_id is null) = (google_place_id_confirmed_by is null)

places_google_id_check.name: places_google_id_check
places_google_id_check.value: google_place_id is null or (google_place_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$' and length(google_place_id) between 10 and 300)

places_opened_check.name: places_opened_check
places_opened_check.value: (opened_on is null) = (opened_precision is null) and coalesce(opened_precision in ('day', 'month'), true)

places_target_check.name: places_target_check
places_target_check.value: (target_on is null) = (target_precision is null) and coalesce(target_precision in ('day', 'month'), true)

places_open_check.name: places_open_check
places_open_check.value: status <> 'open' or opened_on is not null

places_soon_check.name: places_soon_check
places_soon_check.value: status <> 'opening_soon' or target_on is not null

places_public_check.name: places_public_check
places_public_check.value: status not in ('open', 'opening_soon') or (coalesce(open_to_public, false) and published_at is not null and jsonb_array_length(sources) > 0)

places_lat_check.name: places_lat_check
places_lat_check.value: lat is null or (lat between -90 and 90 and lng between -180 and 180)

event_proposals_shadow_check.name: event_proposals_shadow_check
event_proposals_shadow_check.value: (origin = 'shadow') = (source_id is not null and external_id is not null and draft is not null)

event_proposals_reject_kind_check.name: event_proposals_reject_kind_check
event_proposals_reject_kind_check.value: (reject_kind is null) or (status = 'rejected' and reject_kind in ('wrong_date', 'wrong_venue', 'not_public', 'duplicate', 'filtered', 'outside_area', 'other'))

event_proposals_decided_check.name: event_proposals_decided_check
event_proposals_decided_check.value: (status = 'pending') = (decided_at is null) and (decided_at is null) = (decided_by is null)

feed_discoveries_source_check.name: feed_discoveries_source_check
feed_discoveries_source_check.value: (status <> 'approved' or source_id is not null) and (status <> 'proposed' or source_id is null)

feed_discoveries_decided_check.name: feed_discoveries_decided_check
feed_discoveries_decided_check.value: (status in ('approved', 'rejected')) <= (decided_at is not null) and (decided_at is null) = (decided_by is null)

organizers_verified_check.name: organizers_verified_check
organizers_verified_check.value: status <> 'verified' or last_checked_at is not null

benchmark_items_miss_reason_check.name: benchmark_items_miss_reason_check
benchmark_items_miss_reason_check.value: miss_reason is null or (result = 'missed' and miss_reason in ('no_source', 'social_only', 'not_in_feed', 'filtered', 'rejected', 'wrong_details', 'outside_area', 'permission_pending', 'source_not_enabled', 'other'))

benchmark_items_suggested_reason_check.name: benchmark_items_suggested_reason_check
benchmark_items_suggested_reason_check.value: suggested_reason is null or suggested_reason in ('no_source', 'social_only', 'not_in_feed', 'filtered', 'rejected', 'wrong_details', 'outside_area', 'permission_pending', 'source_not_enabled', 'other')

benchmark_items_task_status_check.name: benchmark_items_task_status_check
benchmark_items_task_status_check.value: task_status is null or (miss_reason = 'no_source' and task_status in ('open', 'done', 'dropped'))

benchmark_items_match_check.name: benchmark_items_match_check
benchmark_items_match_check.value: case result when 'live' then matched_event_id is not null and matched_proposal_id is null when 'missed' then matched_event_id is null and matched_proposal_id is null else matched_proposal_id is not null and matched_event_id is null end
